checks.method: Enumerated j=0 through 4 exactly, tested two rank-five sets intersecting in all four selected points, and inspected FourStar's distinctness hypotheses.
checks.observation: The correction values are 0,0,1,2,2. At j=4, intersection excess is at least 3, so no omitted quadruple term is needed for this lower bound. Distinct rank-four members actually cannot have j=4. Three distinct four-sets containing one selected triple have distinct fourth points and form a sunflower; hence each triple-codegree is at most two.
